_doc: Copy this file to moteurs.json (ignored by git) and adapt it. A MOTEUR (engine) is one Claude account: the folder of Claude Code configuration it runs with. A run picks its engine in <workspace>/state/moteur; otherwise `defaut` applies. Paths may start with ~.

moteurs._note: Optional keys: `compte` (the account e-mail, shown in the console and checked against the folder's real login), `fichier_jeton` (an env file exporting CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, sourced before each agent session).

_claude_version: The Claude Code version the tmux engine was tested with (it reads a TUI screen). When set, run-node.py refuses any other version; FLUX_IGNORER_VERSION=1 bypasses the check. Empty = no check.

serveur._note: Only for runtime/flux-local, when you play an interactive step on another machine than the flux server. FLUX_VPS / FLUX_API override these values.

moteurs_api._doc: Providers of the `api` engine. Anthropic models go through `claude -p` with the run's engine folder (no API key in flux). Ollama and llama.cpp are reached over HTTP; FLUX_OLLAMA_URL / FLUX_LLAMACPP_URL or <workspace>/state/ollama-url override the address.

llamacpp._doc: Optional `ssh`: a host on which `ssh <host> servir <model>` switches the llama-server to another model before a campaign (tools/jouer-lot.py).

tarifs._doc: Dollars per million tokens (public prices), used to give each pass an order-of-magnitude cost. Local models cost 0.
